name: autoprint-workspace
description: AutoPrint / QRPrint Unified Multi-App Production Workspace

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix app/backend && npm install --prefix app/merchant-desktop && npm install --prefix app/customer-web && npm install --prefix tools/system-guard
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:merchant && npm run build:customer && npm run build:launcher
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix app/backend && npm run lint --prefix app/merchant-desktop && npm run lint --prefix app/customer-web
scripts.guard: npm run build --prefix tools/system-guard && npm run guard --prefix tools/system-guard -- status
scripts.guard:scan: npm run build --prefix tools/system-guard && npm run guard --prefix tools/system-guard -- scan
scripts.guard:status: npm run build --prefix tools/system-guard && npm run guard --prefix tools/system-guard -- status
scripts.guard:baseline: npm run build --prefix tools/system-guard && npm run guard --prefix tools/system-guard -- baseline
scripts.guard:recover: npm run build --prefix tools/system-guard && npm run guard --prefix tools/system-guard -- recover
scripts.guard:report: npm run build --prefix tools/system-guard && npm run guard --prefix tools/system-guard -- report
scripts.guard:watch: npm run build --prefix tools/system-guard && npm run guard --prefix tools/system-guard -- watch

author: AutoPrint Engineering
